effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: When this card is destroyed as a result of battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 EARTH monster with an ATK of 1500 or less in face-up Attack Position from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: when the GOAT script's s.operation finds no EARTH monster with 1500 or less ATK in the Deck, it reveals the Deck to prove the whiff (else-branch Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script never reveals. No lineage version carries reveal wording.

changes.historical_text: When this card is destroyed as a result of battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 EARTH monster with an ATK of 1500 or less in face-up Attack Position from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.summary: Era activation semantics, separate from the verification procedure: the GOAT s.target keeps only the free-Monster-Zone check and drops the modern script's Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,...), so the battle-destruction trigger can be activated with no eligible EARTH monster left in the Deck. Nothing in the packet dates the end of this per-card allowance, so its chronology is unresolved.

review.notes: Baseline text matches lineage v2 (SD7-EN003, Structure Deck: Invincible Fortress, 2006-05-15) exactly. That printing postdates the 2005-04-01 GOAT snapshot, where v1 (SYE-020, 2004-03-01) was in force, but the difference is the "sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle" -> "destroyed ... and sent to the Graveyard" rewording, which is cosmetic by the review rules; v2 is the text in force for Edison. Trailing lineage v3 (RP01-EN067, 2008-07-08), v4 (Legendary Collection, 2010-10-01), v5 (YS11-EN012, 2011-07-08), v6 (SDGR-EN020, 2014-10-16) and v7 (SBCB-EN047, 2020-11-26) shuffle the same clauses and abbreviate Graveyard to GY, with v4 briefly reverting to the older phrasing - all cosmetic. Upstream ships one GOAT script encoding both ruling behaviours, so no implementation exists for a state in which only one had changed, and with (B) undated the pair cannot be sequenced. Not listed on EdisonFormat.com's Functional Errata page.
